BiblicalUsage: Kelach, Calah, is one of the most ancient cities of Assyria, built by Asshur. Genesis 10:11 says out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah. Genesis 10:12 says Resen between Nineveh and Calah, the same is a great city.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Calah is the reminder that the great cities of men were built early, and God watched every one of them rise.
